messages.subject: Time recording - October narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our records show 6.5 hours of unposted time for October across two matters. Please complete your narratives by close of business Wednesday so we can finalise the month-end WIP report. Partners have asked us to chase outstanding entries promptly this quarter.

Thanks,
Accounts
